mechanics.claim: The fireball explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range.
mechanics.quote: explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Enemies can only be damaged by one scorched field at a time; a repeat explosion on the same target deals reduced (40%) damage.
mechanics.quote: Enemies may be damaged by only one scorched field at a time. Subsequent explosions against the same target deal {{ap|{{#var:xpl}}*100}}% damage.

mechanics.claim: The fireball applies area damage; in Dragon Form the explosion also applies area damage and the scorched field deals persistent area damage over time.
mechanics.quote: The fireball applies {{tip|area damage}}. In {{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}}, the explosion applies {{tip|area damage}} and the scorched field deals {{tip|persistent area damage}}.

mechanics.claim: In Dragon Form, both the explosion and scorched field are centered on the first champion struck, not the missile's collision point.
mechanics.quote: In ''Dragon Form'', both areas of effect will be centered on the first champion struck, not at the location the missile collided with them.

mechanics.claim: The ability can fail to go on cooldown due to a bug if cast starts in Dragon Form and ends in Human Form.
mechanics.quote: ''Molten Burst'' will fail to go on cooldown if its cast time starts in {{ai|Dragon's Descent|Shyvana|Dragon Form}} and ends in {{sbc|Human Form}}.{{bug}}
